propositions: recheck-review refuses all current-revision findings, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks that could be resolved by earning a plan-review attestation on the ticket without code changes

label copy conditions (NO_CODE_CHANGE, TRIVIAL_REBASE) forward bugfix-size-attestation blocks even after the underlying attestation state changes on the ticket, trapping contributors without a code-change workaround

retrigger must safely accept recheck-review when the block is exactly bugfix-size-attestation and the ticket's plan-review attestation is valid/certified, by re-verifying with the gate's own classifier and bucket logic
retrigger must refuse blocks mixing bugfix-size-attestation with other findings, and refuse when attestation is absent or in stale-material/mismatch/invalid state

retrigger eligibility must read only the bot's vote message and ticket store, never the requesting comment, and must extract the ticket id from commit-message trailer not from finding text to avoid truncation drift
